invariants_acknowledged: Spike run 2026-11-21 against devlikeapro/waha:noweb-2026.10.1 (tier CORE, engine NOWEB) in Docker, bound to 127.0.0.1. 21 cross-tenant calls with tenant A's session key against tenant B's session: 0 succeeded (19 refused with 403, 2 list calls returned A's own session only). Positive controls passed; B was untouched afterwards.
The sessions were created and started but never paired: no real WhatsApp number was used. Memory for a paired session is therefore unmeasured; the per-tenant cost states its assumption.

Closed 2026-11-21 (about 19:05-19:10): the owner, Talysson, approved ADR-089 in Aurora's modal ('Approve (Recommended)'): one shared WAHA container with a session key per tenant, about US$3.30/month plus about US$2 per paired tenant, deployed only at go-live (IFC-331). The ADR status moved from Proposed to Accepted. Spike and ADR merged in PR #1516. Nothing was purchased; the paired-session memory (200 MB) remains an unverified assumption stated in the ADR.
